desc:
👋 Welcome to Ronald's! At our restaurant, you can order some food, work in the kitchen, serve customers, or just hang out with friends. Master your skills to become a pro chef, an expert cashier, and more!

🍔 Hungry? Try our famous Big Ron and Fries! Choose from our menu and order at the counter or via the Self-Ordering Kiosks for a quick and easy experience.

🧑‍💼 Want to work here? Enter the kitchen and press Apply to take the Trainee quiz, or purchase a rank in-game.

🍳 Earn Points & Rank Up! Once you become a staff member, earn Points by preparing meals and working in the kitchen. Collect Points to automatically progress to higher staff ranks!

📖 Staff Rules: Make sure to read our official guidelines before your shift by checking Menus → Staff Handbook.

💬 Join our Roblox community so you don't miss any updates! Make sure to like and favourite the game.

🎁 Free Bonus: Use code RONALDS in Menus → Redeem Codes to get 50 Points!
And SIXSEVEN for 67 Points ;)
